$comment: The traps of this repository, each with a trigger read from a diff, what to check, and where it came from (docs/verification-practices-study.md §2.6). scripts/diff-checklist.mjs prints the items a change triggers. `paths` are regular expressions on the changed paths; `auto` names a check the script runs itself. Prune an item that no longer bites.

items.check: A document with a .ja.md twin (or a .md twin of a .ja.md) changed alone: update both, or say why one stays (packages/wcstack has an English README only).
items.source: CLAUDE.md, Docs & Design Notes: per-package README.md / README.ja.md are normative — update both

items.check: data-wcs syntax, a protocol or router attributes/behaviour may have changed: update the wcstack-skill references (separate repository, wcstack/wcstack-skill) with the release.
items.source: CLAUDE.md, Docs & Design Notes: the wcstack-app skill

items.check: src/version.ts imports this file, so a fresh build renames the chunk holding VERSION: do not commit a rebuilt dist between releases.
A committed dist changed. Dists are rebuilt only at a release; outside one, restore it (git checkout -- packages/<pkg>/dist). The testing build rebuilds state, router and server in place.
items.source: CLAUDE.md, Build Pipeline (two traps around committed dists); #183 (a stale dist stayed green until the release)

items.check: A generated copy changed: edit the canonical source (protocol/, io-core/, config-templates/, emit-builtin-tags.mjs) and re-run its sync script; CI's --check fails on drift.
items.source: CLAUDE.md, Repository Layout (generated copies carry a do-not-edit banner)

items.check: The core has a few bytes left under its 20 KiB limit: build and run scripts/check-state-size.mjs; a fix goes into an add-on unless the author decides otherwise, with its byte count.
items.source: CLAUDE.md, The 4.0 engine: core size target

items.check: Read the header first: a name the DOM, a protocol (protocol-sources.test.ts), a config key, a public method, DevTools or a string lookup reaches must not be listed. Run the bundle, split, quality-core and protocol-sources tests.
items.source: CLAUDE.md, The 4.0 engine: mangle.mjs; the verification study (source was refused by protocol-sources.test.ts)

items.check: A workflow change runs for an open pull request only after its merge ref is rebuilt (gh pr update-branch, or merge main): a reopened PR keeps the old workflow.
items.source: the CI history (a reopened PR ran a stale workflow)

items.check: packages/router/__tests__/routeRange.state.test.ts and devtools' protocol drift test import packages/state/src: run them (CI selects router and devtools for a state change).
A test that passes only on a retry hides a failure: find its cause and fix it, or delete it and write down why — never sleep, skip or retry it green (flaky-summary-reporter.ts lists them).
items.source: docs/verification-practices-study.md §2.4 (four flaky specs hid two defects)
